ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the _ day of ~ 2002, by and between by and between Road, Freehold,New Jersey 07728, and THE TRUSTEES OF COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY IN THE CITY OF NEW YORK ("Developer"), a New York non-profit corporation, having an address at 412 LowMemorial Library,535West 116th Street,NewYork,NewYork10027. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lots 40 and 41 in Block 1875 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and as and by the street address 216 and 218 West 104th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building(s) located thereon is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Manhattan,City,County and State of New York, known as Lot 18 in Block 1875 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 213-223 West 103rd Street a/k/a 2692-2704 Broadway,New York,New York, "Developer Land") the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to enlarge or add additional floors to the Existing Developer Building, and to construct other improvements associated with such enlargement or additional floors (the Existing Developer Building and such enlargement or additional floors, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as 2 KL3.2223616.4

hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined)for utilization in connectionwith the construction and maintenance of theDeveloper Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer inperpetuity; WHEREAS, the parties/hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions(the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term“zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order tocreate a single zoning lot of the OwnerParcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a) “"Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located, (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and (ii) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time. (b)“Excess Development Rights" shall mean all of the Development Rights now or hereafter belonging or appurtenant to the Owner Parcel in excess of the Utilized Development Rights. It is agreed and acknowledged that as of the date hereof the Excess Development Rights comprise 9,937 square feet of floor area. utilized by the Owner Building as of the date hereof. It is agreed and acknowledged that as of the date hereof the Utilized Development Rights comprise 15,095 square feet of floorarea. 3 KL3:2223616 4

(d) "Violation" shall mean any violation of the Zoning Resolution or any building code,fire code,or other law,ordinance or regulation which would adversely affect the issuance of a temporary or permanent Certificate of Occupancy for any building located on the Merged Zoning Lot or prevent the issuance of a building permit or any other permits or approvals required by law to build on any parcel that is part of the Merged Zoning Lot or create a non-compliance by any building located on the Merged Zoning Lot with the Zoning Resolution. (e) "Zoning Resolution” shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, as in effect as of the date hereof and as amended or restated from time to time hereafter. Undefined terms used in thisAgreement which are defined in the Zoning , e mo, n e ro, e ro, ri, ' , 'a coverage," "party in interest," “rooms" or "zoning rooms" and “zoning lot" -- shall be defined and construed as those terms are defined in and construed pursuant to Section 12- 10oftheZoningResolution. 2. Development Limitations. (a) Owner hereby acknowledges that Developer shall have theright to build the Developer Building to any lot lines of the Owner Land contiguous to the Developer Land,as such lot lines exist on the date of this Agreement,and to maintain the Developer Building at such lot lines. Owner hereby grants to Developer a perpetual easement for lightandair,andunobstructed view,over theentireOwner Parcel,except for the air space occupied by the Owner Building as it exists on the date hereof (the “Owner Building Envelope"). Owner covenants and agrees that no new buildings, improvements, alterations or additions shall be constructed or allowed to exist on the OwnerParcel, and no construction, addition, reconstruction, replacement, repair or rebuilding (each, a "Rebuilding") of the Owner Building, whether following a casualty or otherwise, shall be made so as to encroach beyond the Owner Building Envelope into the area of the easement granted herein (but nothing contained in this Section 2(a) shall be deemed to prohibit or restrict the placement or replacement, or continued maintenance, on or above the roof of the Owner Building or any Rebuilding of any parapet, bulkhead, fence, elevator shaft, water tower, antenna, satellite dish, chimney, pipe, ladder, fire escape, or other mechanical or telecommunications equipment, provided the same do not extend more than ten (10) feet above the roof of the Owner Building or any Rebuilding and do not decrease the Excess Development Rights). (b)Owner covenants and agrees that no Rebuilding of the Owner Building shall be made with respect to the Owner Parcel (i) so as to create a non-compliance by theDeveloperBuildingwith anyrequirementof theZoningResolution atthe timeof Development Rights utilized by the Owner Building and the other buildings on the 4 KL3:2223616.4

Merged Zoning Lot and/or the effect of any pending Rebuilding of the other buildings on the Merged Zoning Lot,if such non-compliancewould affectDeveloper's right to obtain a Certificateof Occupancy for theDeveloperBuilding,or would affect Developer's right to construct, maintain, alter or occupy the Developer Building, or (ii) so as to utilize any Development Rights allowed to the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution other than the Utilized Development Rights, as the same may be decreased by a validly enacted amendment to the Zoning Resolution or variance thereof or pursuant to the terms hereof. (c) )Developer covenants and agrees that no Rebuilding shall be made on the Developer Parcel (i) so as to create a non-compliance by the Owner Building with any requirement of the Zoning Resolution at the time of such Rebuilding when the effect of such Rebuilding is considered together with the Development Rights utilized by the Developer Building and the other buildings on the Merged Zoning Lot and/or the effect of any pending Rebuilding of the other buildings on the Merged Zoning Lot, if such noncompliance would affect Owner's right to obtain or maintain a Certificate of Occupancy for the Owner Building, or would adversely affect Owner's right to construct, maintain, alter or occupy the Owner Building, or (ii) except as otherwise provided herein, so as to utilize any Utilized Development Rights as the same may be decreased by a validly enacted amendment to the Zoning Resolution or variance thereof or pursuant to thetermshereof. (p) )Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in Section 2(a) or regulation or ordinance hereafter limits or restricts the Rebuilding of the Owner Building, whether following a casualty or otherwise, to a manner more restrictive than that provided in Section 2(a) or Section 2(b), any such Rebuilding shall be accomplished in compliancewithsuchlimitationorrestriction. (e) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in Section 2(c), Developer covenants and agrees that, in the event any applicable law, rule, regulation or ordinance hereafter limits or restricts the Rebuilding of the Developer Building,whether following a casualty or otherwise, to a manner more restrictive than that provided in Section 2(c), any such Rebuilding shall be accomplished in compliance with such limitationorrestriction. (f) If,following a validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution Building (but not the Developer Building) suffers a casualty, then, subject to the provisions of Section 2(a) andSection 2(b)and irrespective of whether construction of the enlargement of or additions to the Developer Building has commenced or fully completed,the amount of Rebuilding on the Owner Parcel shall be limited by such downzoning to an amount which allows the Developer Parcel the full benefit, and no reduction, of the Excess Development Rights plus all of the Development Rights owned 5 KL3:2223616.4

by Developer and then appurtenant to all portions of the Merged Zoning Lot other than the Owner Parcel (considered as if the Owner Parcel was a separate zoning lot). (g)If, following a validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution reducing the Development Rights appurtenant to the Merged Zoning Lot, the Developer Building (but not the Owner Building) suffers a casualty, then, subject to the provisions of Section 2(c),the total amount of Rebuilding on the Developer Parcel shall be limited by such downzoning to an amount which allows the Owner Parcel the full benefit, and no reduction,of theUtilized Development Rights. (h)If, following a validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution Building and the Developer Building simultaneously suffer a casualty, then, subject to the provisions of Section_2(a) and Section 2(b), the amount of Rebuilding on the Owner Parcel shall be limited by such downzoning to an amount which allows the Developer Parcel the full benefit, and no reduction, of the Excess Development Rights plus all of the Development Rights owned by Developer and then appurtenant to all portions of the Merged Zoning Lot other than the Owner Parcel (considered asif the OwnerParcel was a separate zoning lot). (i)  Developer and Owner agree that following a validly enacted amendment of the Zoning Resolution increasing the Development Rights appurtenant to the Merged Zoning Lot, the Developer Parcel shall be entitled to the full benefit of such increased Development Rights. (i) Owner covenants and agrees not to create or permit to exist any Violation with respect to the Owner Parcel. (k)  Owner covenants and agrees not to enter into any agreement effecting, or purporting to effect, any further merger of the zoning lot in which the Owner Parcel is situated, with any parcel of land not, as of the date of this Agreement, contained in the Merged Zoning Lot. (Il)Developer covenants and agrees not to enter into any agreement effecting, or purporting to effect, any further merger of the zoning lot in which the Developer Parcel is situated with any parcel of land not, as of the date of this Agreement, contained in the Merged Zoning Lot, if such agreement would, in of itself, (i) create a non- compliance by any building on the Merged Zoning Lot with any requirement of the Zoning Resolution, (i) adversely affect the maintenance of a permanent Certificate of Occupancy for the Owner Building, or (i) constitute a Violation. (m) Developer covenants and agrees to cooperate with Owner in all reasonable respects, but at the sole cost and expense of Owner, in connection with any Rebuilding or an alteration or improvement to the Owner Building, provided the same complies with 6 KL3:2223616 4

this Agreement, and Owner shall reimburse to Developer any reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred by Developer in connection therewith. (n)Owner covenants and agrees to cooperate with Developer in all reasonable respects, but at the sole cost and expense of Developer, in connection with any Rebuilding or an alteration, addition or improvement to the Developer Building, provided the same complies with this Agreement, and Developer shall reimburse to Owner any reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred by Owner in connection therewith. (o) Owner acknowledges that the owners of other properties,whether now a part of or which may hereafter be merged into the Merged Zoning Lot, may have reserved or retained certain Development Rights attributable to their properties, and Owner covenants and agrees not to (i) utilize, or attempt to utilize, in the Owner Parcel all or any portion of any such reserved or Utilized Development Rights or (i) make any application to the Department of Buildings of the City of New York (the “Department of OwnerParcel. (p)Owner and Developer agree and acknowledge that as of the date hereof the Utilized Development Rights comprise 15,095 square feet of floor area. Utilization of Excess Development Rights: Cooperation.Pursuant to the Declaration, Owner and Developer have consented to the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot. Owner agrees with Developer that, subject to the terms of this Agreement, Developer may incorporate into the Developer Building all of the Excess Development Rights and otherwise utilize the Excess Development Rights at any time hereafter to develop the Developer Parcel. Except to the extent otherwise provided herein,Owner shall retain all rights in and to the Utilized Development Rights.Owner covenants and agrees to take all appropriate steps reasonably requested by Developer to implement the foregoing (provided the same are without liability to Owner, and Developer shall promptly reimburse to Owner any reasonable out-of- pocket expenses incurred by Owner in connection therewith; and provided, further, that the same do not materially, adversely affect Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights or the Owner Parcel,as utilized on the datehereof, and to the extent permitted under and limited by the Declaration and this Agreement),and, in furtherance thereof, Owner covenants and agrees that: (a)Owner shall cooperate, at Developer's sole cost and expense, with Developerinconnectionwiththe transferof theExcessDevelopmentRights to Developer and the incorporation of the same into Developer Building, including, without limitation, the prosecution of all zoning and variance applications requested by Developer relating thereto and theincorporation therein of theExcessDevelopmentRights,and any application by Developer to increase or decrease the size of the Merged Zoning Lot, subject to the provisions of thisAgreement.Developer shall have the right at any time to make application in its own name, unless otherwise required, to any governmental authority for such licenses, permits, approvals, certificates, rulings, or amendments, as 7 KL32223616.4

shall be necessary or required by Developer as a condition to, or to implement the transfer of,or the utilization byDeveloper of,theExcess Development Rights,including a building permit or permits for the construction of the Developer Building allowing utilization of theExcess Development Rights(collectively,the“Approvals").Developer agrees, if required by the Department of Buildings, to cause the Certificate of Occupancy fortheOwnerBuildingtobeamendedsoastoindicatetheexistenceoftheMerged Zoning Lot.The application therefor shall be prepared by Developer at Developer's expense and shall be forwarded to Owner for Owner's execution (if execution by Owner is required by any governmental authority). Developer shall pay any permit or application fee imposed on such application. Owner agrees, at Developer's sole cost and expense, to cooperate with Developer in connection with the filing and prosecution of applications for the Approvals by giving all necessary consents in connection with the filing and prosecution of applications for the Approvals, if requested, and promptly (and in any event within ten (10) days of receipt) to execute such appropriate documents and applications (including, without limitation, a Plan Work Approval Application (Form PW1) and Form PW1A - Schedule A, all as promulgated by the Department of Buildings from time to time) and tofurnish such information within thepossession or control of, or which can reasonably be obtained by,Owner as may be reasonably requested by Developer for pursuing and obtaining any such approvals, and Developer shall reimburse to Owner any reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred by Owner in connection therewith; (q) hearing brought, sought or defended by Developer before any community board, the New York City Planning Commission or Department of City Planning of the City of New York, the Department of Buildings, the City Council of the City of New York, the Board of Standards and Appeals of the City of New York, or any other municipal, governmental department, court or agency of the City of New York, the State of New York or the United States of America arising out of or in connection with any zoning or variance applications relating to the Developer Building or the Merged Zoning Lot and the incorporation of the Excess Development Rights therein or any other application for or proceeding with respect to an Approval that, in the reasonable judgment of Developer, affects or may affect the ability of Developer to construct or alter the Developer Building and to incorporate the Excess Development Rights into the Developer Building or other improvements on the Merged Zoning Lot, provided Owner may oppose any action which is inconsistent with the Declaration, this Agreement or the Zoning Documents; and (c) Owner shall furnish to Developer upon request copies of all plans, applications and submissions hereafter submitted by Owner to the Department of Buildings or any other city, state or federal agency or authority relating to any proposed Rebuilding or demolition of the Owner Building. 4. Owner Representations. Owner represents and warrants to, and covenants with,Developer that (a)it is seized of the Owner Parcel in fee simple,it has the right to enter into the Declaration,this Agreement and the Zoning Documents and is the only party in interest 8 KL3:2223616.4

withrespectto the OwnerParcel that has notwaived and/or subordinated itsrighttoexecute the transferred, or encumbered the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Parcel in any manner whatsoever, (c) it will execute or procure any further assurances reasonably required by Developer of its right to enter into the Declaration, this Agreement and the Zoning Documents, (d) it will forever warrant and defend the right to utilize the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Parcel for the benefit of Developer, its successors and assigns, subject to applicable zoning and other laws, rules and regulations, (e) the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement by it does not violate the provisions of any mortgage or any other agreement or instrument to which it is a party or by which it is bound, (f) any consideration received by it will be received subject to the provisions of Section 13 of the Lien Law, and (g) it is not a “foreign person"as defined in section 1445(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and the regulationsissued thereunder. 5. Floor Area Notice. Notice is hereby given that this Agreement restricts the Owner Parcel, and benefits the Developer Parcel, by reducing (subject to the terms of this feet of floor area, all of which comprises the Excess Development Rights utilizable by Developer pursuant to this Agreement. 6. Separate Building_Plans.The parties hereto agree that all construction plans and specifications for, and applications for a certificate of occupancy or any building, alteration, demolition or other permits for any building on the OwnerParcel shall be separate and independent from those for any building on the Developer Parcel and vice versa and shall be filed with the Department of Buildings so as to obtain separate “new building” and “alteration" numbers, as appropriate, so long as permitted by applicable law. 7. SeparateTax Lots.Theparties acknowledge that the separateinterestsof each of them require that the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel and any other parcels now or hereafter merged into the Merged Zoning Lot be treated for real property tax purposes as separate and independent tax lots. Owner and Developer shall take such actions, with respect to the Owner Parcel and Developer Parcel, respectively, as may be reasonably required to maintain the Parcels which comprise the Merged Zoning Lot as separate and independent tax lots. Neither Owner nor Developer shall object to, or otherwise oppose, the Parcels being treated as separate tax lots, and neither party shall be precluded from contesting tax assessments on its own Parcel. Developer and Owner each agrees to cooperate with the other in connection with any application, filings or proceedings relating to the assessed valuation of the Owner Parcel and/or the Developer Parcel which may be filed or instituted by the owner of such Parcel in furtherance of theforegoingprovisions of thisSection 7. 8. ViolationCureRights.               ( Owner Parcel which adversely affects the rights of Developer with respect to Developer Parcel, Owner shall commence a cure within fifteen (15) days after receiving notice of 9 KL3:2223616.4

the same from Developer,and shall proceed diligently and continuously to cure,remove and discharge of record the same as rapidly as possible (or, if the cure, removal and discharge cannot with due diligence be completed in such fifteen (15) day period, Owner shall commence the cure, removal and discharge within such fifteen (15) day period and diligently prosecute to completion, the cure, removal and discharge of any Violation). In the eyent that Owner does not commence such cure and proceed diligently and Developer shall have the right to cure such Violation at the expense and for the account of Owner (and if necessary, in the name of Owner), and Owner will execute and deliver such documents as may be required in connection therewith, it being agreed that Developer shall have a license to have access to the Owner Parcel for the purpose of effecting such cure; provided,however, Developer covenants and agrees that such access and cure (i) shall only occur after notice to Owner, (ii) except in the event of an emergency as reasonably determined by Developer, shall only occur at reasonable times, and (i) shall not unreasonably interfere with Owner's use and occupancy of the Owner Building; and provided, further, that during the period of such access and cure, Developer shall procure and maintain liability insurance, naming Owner (and any mortgagee of the Owner Parcel of which Developer has notice)as an additional insured,in the form and in Violation. In addition, Developer may, at its option, maintain any action permitted at law or in equity or by statute against Owner with respect to such Violation, including an damages arising from the failure by Owner to cure such Violation. (b) If Developer is compelled or elects to expend any sum of money or do any acts which require the payment of money by reason of complying with, remedying or curing a Violation on the Owner Parcel, as provided in this Section 8, Owner shall, upon demand, promptly reimburse Developer all such sums together with interest thereon at the lesser of (i) 18% per annum or (ii) maximum rate permitted by law, compounded annually,fromthedateofsuchexpenditure.DevelopershallhavealienonOwner's property in the amount of all such sums and interest not reimbursed by Owner in accordancewiththisSection8(b). 9. Subdivision.Developer shall have the right to subdivide the Developer Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot to the extent permitted by the Zoning Resolution and other applicable law, provided that such subdivision shall be subject to this Agreement and shall not adversely diminishOwner's right toutilize theUtilized DevelopmentRights or the Owner Parcel, as utilized on the date hereof, and as limited by the Declaration and this Agreement. Owner shall not have the right to subdivide the Owner Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot. Developer shall not apply for any such subdivision without first furnishing Owner with: (i) a copy of the application, and (ii) the opinion of an architect licensed in New York State, familiar of the subdivision and concluding that the subdivisionwill not diminish Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights or the Owner Parcel, as utilized on the date hereof, and as limited by the Declaration and this Agreement. Owner shall cooperate with Developer in 10 KL3:2223616.4

connection with any such subdivision, provided Developer shall pay any reasonable out-of- pocketfees andexpensesincurredby Owner(including,butnotlimitedto,attorneys’andother professionals'fees and expenses)in connection therewith. 10. Merged Zoning Lot,including Owner, are hereby deemed to have consented to and waived objection to enlarging theMerged ZoningLot covered by theDeclaration toinclude one or more additional parcels to be brought into the Merged Zoning Lot, and to have consented, subordinated and waived objection to each addition, modification, amendment, replacement, restatement or consolidation (each individually,an “Amendment,"and collectively "Amendments") to the Declaration and/or this Agreement, whether or not such parties sign such addition,modification,amendment,replacement,restatement or consolidation to theDeclaration and/or this Agreement, subject to all the other terms and conditions of this Agreement, provided that such Amendment does not, by its terms, materially and adversely affect Owner's right to utilize the Utilized Development Rights or the Owner Parcel, as utilized on the date hereof, and as limited by the Declaration and this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if requested by Developer, Owner shall, within fifteen (15) days after such request, execute, acknowledge anddeliver one ormoreAmendments to theDeclarationand/or thisAgreement,or execute a waiver of Declaration or subordination to this Agreement, and shall execute, acknowledge and deliver,or cause the execution,acknowledgement and delivery of, such other instruments as may reasonably be required, for the purposes of such enlargement of the Merged Zoning Lot. In the event that Owner shall not haveexecuted and delivered,or caused tohave executed and delivered,within fifteen(15) days after demand therefor,any of the documents orinstruments herein referred to, then Developer shall have the right to execute any such documents or instruments for, on behalf of, and as attorney-in-fact for Owner. In furtherance of the foregoing, Owner hereby irrevocably appoints Developer as its true and lawful attormey-in-fact, coupled with an interest, to execute any and all such documents or instruments. Developer shall furnish Owner with such documents as Owner may reasonably require in order to be assured that the enlarging of the Merged Zoning Lot is consistent with the terms of this Agreement.Developer shall pay any reasonable out-of-pocket fees and expenses incurred by Owner (including, but not limited to, attorneys’ and other professionals’ fees and expenses) in connection with the review, execution,acknowledgement and deliveryof the documents pertainingto enlarging theMerged ZoningLotpursuanttothisSection10. 11. TemporaryEasementsforSupports,ProtectiveCoveringand Construction. (a) Owner grants to Developer easements in the Owner Parcel to use such portions of the Owner Parcel and the Owner Building as are required for the demolition of the Existing Developer Building and the construction, alteration or rebuilding of the Developer Building (collectively, “Construction"). Construction may include, to the extent required by good construction practice,(i) the attachment of foundation and building supports and shoring and bracing of the Owner Building, (i) the attachment of protective covering over the roof, facade and other portions of the Owner Building if required to safeguard the Owner Building from debris during Construction,(ii) the 11 KL3:2223616.4

maintenance, repair and replacement of such attachments, provided that the manner of attachments shall be in accordance with good construction practice and in a manner customary for improvements of such type and so as not to impose an excessive load on the Owner Building (but nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed to permit Developer to place any equipment or materials (including temporary construction equipment) on the roof or the rear yards of the Owner Parcel), and (iv) the right to construct and maintain temporary scaffolding on the Owner Building or the Owner Parcel during Construction,provided that such scaffolding shall be constructed and maintained in compliance with good construction practice, shall provide for adequate security with respect to the OwnerParcel,and shall not unreasonably interfere with ingress and egress to the Owner Building. Developer shall give Owner five (5) days’written notice prior to the commencement of the construction of any such scaffolding. (b) All of the easement rights set forth in this Agreement shall be exercised (i) in a prompt, safe and efficient manner and so as not to unreasonably interfere with the use, occupancy or structural integrity of the Owner Parcel or the buildings and such precautions as may be necessary or appropriate to prevent damage to the Owner Parcel or injury to persons; and (i) so that on completion of any work, the area of any such work is restored to its former condition (insofar as possible) with all debris removed. (?) During Construction, Developer shall, at its sole cost and expense, obtain and at all times maintain or cause to be obtained and maintained public liability insurance coverage to include personal injury, bodily injury, broad form property damage, operations hazard, independent contractor's coverage, contractual liability and products and completed operations liability, naming Owner as an additional insured, in amounts customarily maintained by a prudent contractor/developer/owner performing such work. (d)Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, Owner consents to, and grants to Developer an easement for, temporary projections and/or intrusions extending from the Developer Parcel into the air space over the improved or unimproved portions of the Owner Parcel which are reasonably required in connection with the construction of the Developer Building, provided that such projections and/or intrusions (i) are not in violation of applicable law, (i) do not unreasonably interfere with Owner's use and occupancy of the Owner Building, (i) are removed promptly after completion of the Developer Building, and (iv) are made in accordance with the terms and requirements of this Agreement (including the requirementsofthisSection 11). 12.No Third Party Beneficiaries. No covenant or agreement contained herein shall inure to the benefit of any party, including, without limitation, any occupant of either the Developer Parcel or the Owner Parcel, other than to Owner and Developer, their respective heirs, distributees, successors and assigns, and any mortgagee of either the Developer Parcel or the 12 KL3:2223616.4

provided herein.
